49/S0.subgoal: Identify the two primary optimization requirements in immersive VR experiences (psychophysiological and technological).

49/S1.subgoal: Explain how experience optimization relates to minimizing cyber sickness and recap its known causes.

49/S2.subgoal: Describe the core challenge of VR optimization and the various techniques used for virtual locomotion (VLTs).

49/S3.subgoal: Compare and contrast user-controlled and system-controlled virtual tours.

49/S4.subgoal: Explain why matching the user's instantaneous walking speed is essential for achieving presence in system-controlled VR tours.

49/S5.subgoal: Summarize the framework for optimizing VR experience by balancing cyber sickness and maintaining presence.
